releases.body:
Patch release: fix npm install (plugin failed to load from npm).

- Embedded the Solid JSX transform pragma in src/tui.tsx so opencode's runtime transpiler selects Solid instead of defaulting to React ("Cannot find package 'react'").
- Shipped tsconfig.json was considered but dropped to match the established opencode TUI plugin convention (pre-built dist is the long-term target; tracked for 0.2.0).
- Version bump 0.1.0 → 0.1.1 (0.1.0 cannot be republished).

npm: `npm install opencode-git-config-sync@0.1.1`

Initial release.

- Live config repo status in the TUI status bar (`cfg ↑N ↓N ●N`) and session sidebar (changed files with line counts).
- Outdated warning (red status, `❗ OUTDATED!` sidebar banner, daily toast) when commits or uncommitted files are older than 24h.
- `/config-sync`: stage, commit with a confirmed message, `pull --rebase`, update submodules, push.
- `/config-sync-setup`: start a new config repo or adopt an existing remote (with undo on failure).
- `/config-sync-refresh`: refresh status and re-show the outdated warning.
- Submodule handling: moved pointers count as changes; unpushed submodule commits are detected and block sync.
- Works with any git host (SSH or credential helper); no tokens required for the plugin itself.

npm: `npm install opencode-git-config-sync` (or add to `cli.json` plugins).
